description: edge-connexion configuration using edge-common 5.0.0. Values come from the existing ModuleDescriptor and runtime defaults; they have not been verified against the Bugfest baseline (3 standalone tenants and 11 consortia tenants). Null values require deployment-specific input or indicate no recommended override; see each description. ADR-0013 schema validation is pending. This module has no database and does not use a Eureka sidecar.

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU allocation recommendation is pending deployment baseline verification.

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Container memory limit in MiB. The existing ModuleDescriptor specifies 35913941 bytes (approximately 34.25 MiB); a recommended limit remains undetermined pending deployment baseline verification.

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation recommendation is pending deployment baseline verification.

java.name: MaxRAMPercentage
java.description: Maximum heap as a percentage of available memory, matching the existing JAVA_OPTIONS setting.

deployment.description: Multiple instances can serve independent Connexion TCP connections with the same backend and secure-store configuration. Authentication caches are local to each instance. Recommended replica count remains undetermined pending deployment baseline verification.

kong.description: Connexion uses a TCP protocol on port 8081 by default, with HTTP GET health checks on the same listener. No module-specific Kong HTTP timeout recommendation applies to incoming Connexion traffic; configure TCP routing separately.

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: JVM options passed by the container launcher, matching the ModuleDescriptor. Append -Dokapi_url=<backend URL> (required unless supplied in Vert.x configuration). Optional Java system properties: -Dport=8081, -Dlogin_strategy=key (key or full), -Dsecure_store=ephemeral (ephemeral, AwsSsm or Vault), -Dsecure_store_props=<properties file path or URL>, -Dlog_level=INFO and -Drequest_timeout_ms=30000 (outbound connection and idle timeout). In key mode, configure the secure store with institutional-user credentials; full mode takes tenant, user and password from the Connexion request. These properties are not standalone environment variables. The edge-common token_cache_* properties do not tune the refresh-token cache used for Connexion imports, which has a fixed capacity of 100. api_key_sources and response_compression do not apply to this TCP listener. Keep jdk.internal.httpclient.disableHostnameVerification at its default false.

EnvVars.name: SPRING_SSL_BUNDLE_JKS_WEBSERVER_KEYSTORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Optional server keystore type, for example JKS, PKCS12 or BCFKS. Setting a non-empty value enables TLS on the Connexion and health-check listener and requires keystore location and password. Leave unset for a plain TCP listener.

EnvVars.name: SPRING_SSL_BUNDLE_JKS_WEBSERVER_KEYSTORE_LOCATION
EnvVars.description: Path to the server keystore mounted in the container. Required when server TLS is enabled.

EnvVars.name: SPRING_SSL_BUNDLE_JKS_WEBSERVER_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Server keystore password supplied through deployment secret management. Required when server TLS is enabled.

EnvVars.name: SPRING_SSL_BUNDLE_JKS_WEBSERVER_KEY_ALIAS
EnvVars.description: Optional alias of the server key within the keystore.

EnvVars.name: SPRING_SSL_BUNDLE_JKS_WEBSERVER_KEY_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Optional password for the selected server key if separately protected. Supply through deployment secret management.

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_CLIENT_TLS_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enable TLS for outbound FOLIO web-client connections. Use an HTTPS okapi_url for a TLS backend. Custom truststore settings are optional.

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORETYPE
EnvVars.description: Optional outbound TLS truststore type, for example JKS, PKCS12 or BCFKS. A custom truststore is applied only when TLS is enabled and type, path and password are all non-empty.

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTOREPATH
EnvVars.description: Path to the custom outbound TLS truststore mounted in the container. Set together with truststore type and password.

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTOREPASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Custom outbound TLS truststore password supplied through deployment secret management. Set together with truststore type and path.
